setup.run: apt-get update -q >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -q nginx >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -q rsync >/dev/null 2>&1

adduser --quiet --disabled-password --comment 'Site deploys' deploy && install -d -o deploy -g deploy /var/www/ana.example && printf ' ana.example

Hello from ana.example

' > /var/www/ana.example/index.html && chown deploy:deploy /var/www/ana.example/index.html

setup: su - ana -c "ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C ana@laptop -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh-keyscan -q -t ed25519 192.0.2.10 > ~/.ssh/known_hosts" && cat ~ana/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

setup.run: install -d -m 700 -o ana -g ana ~ana/.ssh && install -m 600 -o ana -g ana /dev/stdin ~ana/.ssh/authorized_keys
